raw_comment: I live in Ohio, and I can see that the southeastern part of our state is in a severe drought. This is unusual since we traditionally get plenty of rain. I also see that the upper Great Lakes are also quite dry. Does this map show the effects of climate change?  Is the drought in many places related to a lack of snow from the previous year?
